comment: The negative variants that today's tools can run, on the complete-folder rendition (settings.plateaus). Each case is Brightcart's folders/ with the alteration `ops` (replace: the text must occur once or more, the first occurrence is replaced; write; copy; delete; paths are relative to the folder). Nothing negative is committed as a workspace: BrightcartNegativeCasesTest.java (command line) and brightcart-negative.test.js (editor) build each altered folder in a temporary folder from folders/ and check `cli` and `editor` below. `cli`: the arguments after `archicode -w <workspace>`, the exit code and the lines of the error output (one `error:` line, or a warning line, and no stack trace); `sameStdoutAs`: another command whose standard output is the same. `editor`: the plateau the page switches to and what it compares it with (`@baseline`), then what it shows: fatalError, plateauProblem, baselineProblem, manifestErrors (file -> text), duplicates, warnings (those of the comparison); `comparedWith` is the plateau the comparison draws against. An entry `editor: null` has a `reason`: the page has nothing to type.
